goal: Tighten Bakeoff build CLI/report so handoff output is honest about whether there is a selected patch: surface selected-patch path only when decision.json.canonical_winner is non-null, explicitly say 'no selected patch' when unresolved/judge-failed, and stop recommending build judge-only rerun.
background:
Acceptance criteria:
- When decision.json.canonical_winner is a non-empty string, build handoff output surfaces exactly the path <out>/<run-id>/providers/<winner>/build/diff.patch as the selected patch.
- When canonical_winner is null/absent (unresolved or judge-failed build), build handoff output explicitly states there is no selected patch and does NOT print any providers/<x>/build/diff.patch line.
- Build handoff output never recommends 'bakeoff rerun <run-id> --judge-only' for any build run, including exit 4 / judge-failed cases.
- Focused tests in internal/commands/buildcmd and/or internal/summary cover canonical-winner success, unresolved disagreement / exit 3, and judge-failed build / exit 4 cases; assertions cover selected-patch presence/absence and absence of judge-only-rerun advice.
- go test ./internal/commands/buildcmd ./internal/summary passes.
Bakeoff will capture candidate patches from isolated worktrees and will not apply them to this checkout.

build.comparison_goal: Prefer the patch that satisfies the acceptance criteria with the smallest maintainable change.
